items.headline: US Senate advances landmark crypto bill before heading on August recess
items.summary: The digest says Senate leadership moved to advance a major digital-asset market structure bill before the August recess.

items.headline: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
items.summary: The digest highlights proposed XRP Ledger privacy and institutional features aimed at tokenized financial assets.

items.headline: Wells Fargo launches tokenized deposits on a dual track
items.summary: The digest says Wells Fargo announced a proprietary tokenized deposit platform targeted for select corporate and institutional users.

items.headline: Bitcoin and ether ETFs draw $1.1 billion in best inflow week since April
items.summary: The digest reports a strong week of spot crypto ETF inflows, with Bitcoin products recording inflows across all five sessions.

items.headline: Tokenized real-world asset deposits rise to $7.4 billion
items.summary: The digest says RWA deposits tripled to about $7.4 billion, led by tokenized Treasuries, funds and private credit.

items.headline: Circle CEO says Arc is a major opportunity for institutional settlement
items.summary: The digest highlights Circle's focus on Arc and its potential role in institutional settlement and USDC infrastructure.

items.headline: Tron adds about $2.2 billion in stablecoins over 30 days
items.summary: The digest points to a large increase in stablecoin balances on Tron during the period ending August 4.

items.headline: Weak July jobs data shifts expectations around the Federal Reserve
items.summary: The digest includes coverage suggesting the July jobs report changed expectations for the next Federal Reserve policy move.
